test_hk_jit: test that stateful.jit produces identical init and apply results compared to non-jitted Haiku modules
test_hk_scan: test that hk.scan over a sequence produces identical params and outputs as jax.lax.scan
test_hk_remat: test that hk.remat gradients match jax.remat gradients for non-recurrent Haiku modules
test_optimize_rng_use: test that hk.experimental.optimize_rng_use produces identical params and outputs under jax.jit
test_vmap: test that hk.vmap produces identical outputs as jax.vmap with unmapped params, state, and rng
